name: Basic Fantasy Magic Items
description: Magic weapons, armour, potions, scrolls, wands, staves, rods, miscellaneous and rare items from the Basic Fantasy Role-Playing Game Core Rules, 4th edition (release 142), Copyright © 2006-2025 Chris Gonnerman, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The descriptions are shortened and rewritten for play, and Armour Class bonuses are given for descending AC. Weapon and armour items are generic: rename them after the weapon or armour and fill in its damage. Under the ShareAlike terms this library is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 too. See LICENSE-bfrpg.md next to the core library.

documents.name: Basic Fantasy RPG Core Rules r142 (text only)

entities.name: Weapon +1
entities.description: A magic weapon that adds +1 to attack and damage rolls. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +2
entities.description: A magic weapon that adds +2 to attack and damage rolls. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +3
entities.description: A magic weapon that adds +3 to attack and damage rolls. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +4
entities.description: A magic weapon that adds +4 to attack and damage rolls. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +5
entities.description: A magic weapon that adds +5 to attack and damage rolls. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, +2 vs. Special Enemy
entities.description: A magic weapon made to fight one kind of creature: +1 to attack and damage, or +2 against its special enemy (dragons, enchanted creatures, lycanthropes, regenerators, spell users or undead; roll 1d6 or choose). Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon. Set the Special Enemy.

entities.name: Weapon +1, +3 vs. Special Enemy
entities.description: A magic weapon made to fight one kind of creature: +1 to attack and damage, or +3 against its special enemy (dragons, enchanted creatures, lycanthropes, regenerators, spell users or undead; roll 1d6 or choose). Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon. Set the Special Enemy.

entities.name: Cursed Weapon -1
entities.description: A cursed weapon with -1 on attack rolls, which the wielder can't get rid of. The GM picks the curse. Obsession: the wielder thinks it is a great magic weapon and won't use another; remove curse gets rid of it, but the wielder may save vs. Spells to resist. Affliction: the wielder knows it is cursed after its first fight, but it returns to hand whenever another weapon is drawn; remove curse works without a save. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Cursed Weapon -2
entities.description: A cursed weapon with -2 on attack rolls, which the wielder can't get rid of. The GM picks the curse. Obsession: the wielder thinks it is a great magic weapon and won't use another; remove curse gets rid of it, but the wielder may save vs. Spells to resist. Affliction: the wielder knows it is cursed after its first fight, but it returns to hand whenever another weapon is drawn; remove curse works without a save. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Casts Light on Command
entities.description: Drawn and commanded, the weapon glows with the light of a light spell until sheathed, put down or commanded again. As often as wanted. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Charm Person
entities.description: Once a day the wielder can brandish the weapon, speak its command word and gaze at a creature to cast charm person on it. The target need not meet the gaze, and saves as for the spell. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Drains Energy
entities.description: A hit drains one life energy level, as the Energy Drain rules describe. After 2d4 levels the weapon loses this power but keeps its other magic. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Flames on Command
entities.description: On command the weapon burns with fire that doesn't harm the wielder, until commanded again, dropped or sheathed. Its damage counts as fire, it gets +1 more damage against trolls, treants and others hurt by fire, and it lights and burns like a torch. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Locate Objects
entities.description: Once a day the wielder can cast locate object as an 8th level Magic-User. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Weapon +1, Wishes
entities.description: The weapon grants 1d4 wishes, which the GM rules on. When they are used up it keeps its other bonuses and powers. The weapon's bonus comes from another roll on the Weapon Bonus table; +1 here. Rename it after the weapon (such as Longsword +1) and fill in the weapon's own damage die, and Long Range for a missile or thrown weapon.

entities.name: Armour +1
entities.description: Magic leather armour, chain mail or plate mail that improves Armour Class by 1 beyond its normal value. Rename it after the armour, such as Plate Mail +1. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Shield +1
entities.description: A magic shield that improves Armour Class by 1 more than a normal shield. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Armour +2
entities.description: Magic leather armour, chain mail or plate mail that improves Armour Class by 2 beyond its normal value. Rename it after the armour, such as Plate Mail +2. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Shield +2
entities.description: A magic shield that improves Armour Class by 2 more than a normal shield. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Armour +3
entities.description: Magic leather armour, chain mail or plate mail that improves Armour Class by 3 beyond its normal value. Rename it after the armour, such as Plate Mail +3. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Shield +3
entities.description: A magic shield that improves Armour Class by 3 more than a normal shield. Enter the armour's normal Armour Class on the character; the magic bonus is taken off it on the sheet.

entities.name: Cursed Armour -1
entities.description: Cursed armour (or shield) that worsens Armour Class by 1. It detects as magic, and the curse shows only when the wearer is hit in combat; from then it can't be taken off without remove curse or stronger magic.

entities.name: Cursed Armour -2
entities.description: Cursed armour (or shield) that worsens Armour Class by 2. It detects as magic, and the curse shows only when the wearer is hit in combat; from then it can't be taken off without remove curse or stronger magic.

entities.name: Cursed Armour -3
entities.description: Cursed armour (or shield) that worsens Armour Class by 3. It detects as magic, and the curse shows only when the wearer is hit in combat; from then it can't be taken off without remove curse or stronger magic.

entities.name: Cursed Armour AC 11
entities.description: Cursed armour that tests as +1 but gives ascending Armour Class 11 (descending 8) whatever its type; Dexterity and shield bonuses still count. Once the wearer is hit in combat it can't be removed without remove curse or stronger magic. Set the character's Armour Class to 8 before Dexterity and shield.

entities.name: Potion of Clairaudience
entities.description: The drinker hears what a living creature up to 60 feet away hears, otherwise as the clairvoyance spell.

entities.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
entities.description: Gives the drinker the clairvoyance spell.

entities.name: Potion of Cold Resistance
entities.description: Gives the drinker the resist cold spell.

entities.name: Potion of Control Animal
entities.description: Like a potion of control human, but works only on normal, non-magical animals.

entities.name: Potion of Control Dragon
entities.description: Like a potion of control human, but works only on dragons.

entities.name: Potion of Control Giant
entities.description: Like a potion of control human, but works only on giants.

entities.name: Potion of Control Human
entities.description: The drinker can charm a humanoid by gazing at it, as charm person. If the target resists, up to two more targets can be tried before the potion is spent.

entities.name: Potion of Control Plant
entities.description: The drinker commands the plants and plant creatures in a 10 foot square up to 50 feet away. Normal plants move 10 feet and obey; only the largest can harm, with +0 to attack and 1d4 damage. Plant creatures that fail a save vs. Spells understand the drinker and act as if under charm monster.

entities.name: Potion of Control Undead
entities.description: The drinker commands 3d6 hit dice of undead, which may save vs. Spells to resist. Mindless undead obey exactly; free-willed ones act as if under charm person.

entities.name: Potion of Delusion
entities.description: A cursed potion that tests as some other potion (never poison). The drinker briefly believes they have its benefits, until the illusion is found out.

entities.name: Potion of Diminution
entities.description: Shrinks the drinker and all their gear to one twelfth of their height (a 6 foot warrior becomes 6 inches tall and weighs under 2.5 ounces). They can't hurt anything bigger than a house cat, but can slip under doors and through cracks, and have a 90% chance to move about unseen and unheard.

entities.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
entities.description: Gives the drinker the resist fire spell.

entities.name: Potion of Flying
entities.description: Gives the drinker the fly spell.

entities.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entities.description: The drinker and their gear turn to mist: immune to non-magical weapons and AC 22 against magical ones, unable to attack, cast spells, use supernatural abilities or handle objects. They fly at 10 feet, pass through cracks, are pushed by wind, and can't enter liquid or end the form early. It can be drunk in thirds, each lasting 1d4+1 turns.

entities.name: Potion of Giant Strength
entities.description: The drinker gets a giant's strength: +5 to attack and damage with melee and thrown weapons, and can throw large stones as a stone giant does.

entities.name: Potion of Growth
entities.description: The drinker and their gear grow to twice their height and eight times their weight, with a stone giant's strength (but not its rock throwing): +5 to attack and damage.

entities.name: Potion of Healing
entities.description: Heals 1d6+1 hit points, as cure light wounds.

entities.name: Potion of Heroism
entities.description: Improves fighting ability. Fighters of level 1 to 3 get +3 to attack and 3 extra hit dice, levels 4 and 5 get +2 and 2 hit dice, levels 6 and 7 get +1 and 1 hit die; Fighters of 8th level or more and all other classes get +1 to attack only. Damage comes off the extra hit points first, and what is left of them goes when the potion ends.

entities.name: Potion of Invisibility
entities.description: Makes the drinker invisible, as the spell. It can be drunk in thirds, each lasting 1d4+1 turns.

entities.name: Potion of Invulnerability
entities.description: Gives +2 to Armour Class (2 off descending AC).

entities.name: Potion of Levitation
entities.description: Gives the drinker the levitate spell.

entities.name: Potion of Longevity
entities.description: Makes the drinker 1d10 years younger.

entities.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entities.description: Gives the drinker the mind reading spell.

entities.name: Potion of Poison
entities.description: Not a potion but a trap: the drinker must save vs. Poison or die, even from a sip.

entities.name: Potion of Polymorph Self
entities.description: Gives the drinker the polymorph self spell.

entities.name: Potion of Speed
entities.description: Gives the drinker the haste spell.

entities.name: Potion of Treasure Finding
entities.description: The drinker at once knows the direction and rough distance of the largest hoard of coins within 300 feet. It finds platinum, gold, electrum, silver and copper, but not gems or magic items.

entities.name: Cleric Spell Scroll
entities.description: A scroll of one to four Cleric spells, each used once. Only a Cleric can use it, and only if they know the language it is written in. There is a 10% chance of failure for each spell level above the highest the Cleric can cast. Roll each spell's level on the Spell Scrolls table (d%: 01-30 1st, 31-55 2nd, 56-75 3rd, 76-88 4th, 89-97 5th, 98-00 6th).

entities.name: Magic-User Spell Scroll
entities.description: A scroll of one to seven Magic-User spells, each used once. Only a Magic-User can use it, after casting read magic on the scroll once. Casting a spell they don't know has a 10% chance of failure, plus 10% for each spell level above the highest they can cast. Roll each spell's level on the Spell Scrolls table (d%: 01-30 1st, 31-55 2nd, 56-75 3rd, 76-88 4th, 89-97 5th, 98-00 6th).

entities.name: Cursed Scroll
entities.description: Anyone who reads it, or even glances at it, is cursed. The GM decides the curse and whether a save is allowed (usually vs. Spells). Bestow curse is a starting point, but the curse can be stronger or stranger.

entities.name: Protection from Elementals
entities.description: Any class can read it, if they know its language. It makes a 10 foot circle around the reader that moves with them, and elementals can't enter it. Allies inside are protected too. If anyone inside makes a melee attack on one of them, the circle breaks.

entities.name: Protection from Lycanthropes
entities.description: Any class can read it, if they know its language. It makes a 10 foot circle around the reader that moves with them, and lycanthropes can't enter it. Allies inside are protected too. If anyone inside makes a melee attack on one of them, the circle breaks.

entities.name: Protection from Undead
entities.description: Any class can read it, if they know its language. It makes a 10 foot circle around the reader that moves with them, and undead can't enter it. Allies inside are protected too. If anyone inside makes a melee attack on one of them, the circle breaks.

entities.name: Protection from Magic
entities.description: Any class can read it. For 1d4 turns no magic, from spells or items, can cross the 10 foot circle around the reader in either direction. The circle moves with the reader.

entities.name: Treasure Map
entities.description: Usually not magical. The GM draws the map, to treasure of type A, E or G or to 1d4 magic items, and the treasure is normally guarded by a monster.

entities.name: Rod of Cancellation
entities.description: Works once. Struck against a magic item, it destroys all the item's magic, and the rod's own. Hitting an item someone holds takes an attack roll.

entities.name: Snake Staff
entities.description: A walking staff +1. In a Cleric's hands, on a hit it can turn into a constrictor snake instead of doing damage, holding a target up to man size for 1d4 turns unless it saves vs. Spells. The snake has AC 15, moves 20 feet a round and has 20 hit points, healed when it turns back; killed, it becomes a broken stick. It returns to the Cleric's hand when called, when the hold ends or when the save is made. It has no charges and can be used any number of times.

entities.name: Staff of Commanding
entities.description: Casts charm person or charm monster, or works as a potion of control plant. Each use costs one charge. Saves against it are rolled on the Spells column.

entities.name: Staff of Healing
entities.description: Heals 1d6+1 hit points for each charge spent, as cure light wounds, or casts cure disease for two charges. Only a Cleric can use it.

entities.name: Staff of Power
entities.description: For one charge each: lightning bolt (6d6), fireball (6d6), cone of cold as the wand (6d6), continual light, and telekinesis as the device (at most 1d6 turns). It is also a walking staff +2 that strikes as a staff of striking. Broken in a retributive strike, it releases all its charges in a 30 foot radius, 1d6 damage per charge to everyone there, wielder included (save vs. Spells for half). Out of charges, it is still a walking staff +2.

entities.name: Staff of Striking
entities.description: No attack bonus, but it hits monsters that need a +1 weapon, and any class can fight with it. A Cleric who speaks its command word can spend one, two or three charges to add 1d6, 2d6 or 3d6 damage to the staff's next hit, as the spell striking; the effect fades after a turn if unused.

entities.name: Staff of Wizardry
entities.description: Everything a staff of power does, and also invisibility, passwall, web and conjure elementals (conjuring staff elementals), for one charge each.

entities.name: Wand of Cold
entities.description: A cone of cold, 30 feet wide at 40 feet from the tip, doing 6d8 damage (save vs. Wands for half). One charge a use.

entities.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
entities.description: For one round, every enemy of the user within 60 feet glows greenish white, even hidden or invisible ones, but not those completely out of sight. Enemies are creatures meaning to harm the user, and all undead and animated constructs. One charge a use.

entities.name: Wand of Fear
entities.description: Casts cause fear, the reverse of remove fear. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Fireballs
entities.description: Casts fireball, doing 6d6 damage. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Illusion
entities.description: Creates illusions as phantasmal force. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
entities.description: Casts lightning bolt, doing 6d6 damage. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Magic Detection
entities.description: Works as detect magic. One charge a use.

entities.name: Wand of Paralysis
entities.description: Works as hold person. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Polymorph
entities.description: Casts polymorph self or polymorph other. One charge a use. Saves against it are rolled on the Wands column.

entities.name: Wand of Secret Door Detection
entities.description: Like find traps, but shows secret doors instead of traps. One charge a use.

entities.name: Wand of Trap Detection
entities.description: Works as find traps. One charge a use.

entities.name: Horn of Blasting
entities.description: Played, it blasts a cone 10 feet long and 2 feet wide at the base: 2d6 damage and deafness for a turn to those in it, or half damage and a round of deafness with a save vs. Death Ray. Against buildings and fortifications it does double damage. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a drum.

entities.name: Cloak of Blending
entities.description: The wearer is almost invisible, with an 80% chance to move about unnoticed. Once seen, they can be attacked normally. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Cold Resistance
entities.description: The wearer is protected as by resist cold, all the time. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Helm of Comprehension
entities.description: The wearer can read any language, magical writing included (with the limits of read languages for ordinary texts). It gives no magical ability, but a Magic-User wearing it has read magic all the time. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Control Animal
entities.description: At will, the wearer can charm an animal they can see within 60 feet, as charm person, up to 6 hit dice of animals in all. Giant animals count; fantastic creatures and anything smarter than a dog or cat don't. The wearer can free controlled animals to control new ones. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Control Human
entities.description: Once a round, at will, the wearer can cast charm person on anyone they can see within 60 feet, up to 6 hit dice or levels of humanoids at a time. The wearer can free controlled creatures to control new ones. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Control Plant
entities.description: At will, the wearer gets the effect of a potion of control plant on plants or plant creatures they can see within 60 feet, for as long as they stay within 60 feet of them. Saves as for the potion. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Horn of Courage
entities.description: Played, it affects every friend of the user within 60 feet as remove fear. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a drum.

entities.name: Cloak of Deception
entities.description: Attackers see the wearer 3 feet from where they really are, as a Deceiver does: each attacker's first strike always misses, and later ones have -2 to hit. It doesn't fool mindless creatures, constructs or undead, but works on other living creatures even if they don't see. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Delusion
entities.description: A cursed item. The wearer believes it is some other useful magic item and acts that way, such as believing themselves invisible. Being hurt doesn't end the delusion; only remove curse gets rid of it. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Bell, belt, boots, bowl, cloak, crystal ball, drums, helm, horn, lens, mirror, pendant or ring (column A)

entities.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
entities.description: Rubbed while worn, it summons the djinni bound to it, who arrives the next round and protects, serves and obeys the wearer for up to an hour. Once a day. If the djinni is slain, the item loses its magic. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Drums of Doom
entities.description: Once a day, played, it raises up to 3d6 hit dice of skeletons or zombies, as animate dead, from remains within 60 feet, skeletons first. A Magic-User or Cleric controls them while they keep the device; for anyone else they attack the living nearby. At most 18 hit dice of its undead can exist at once. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a drum.

entities.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
entities.description: The wearer is protected as by resist fire, all the time. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Invisibility
entities.description: On command, the wearer becomes invisible as the spell, for up to 24 hours. If the invisibility is dispelled, the item can't be used again for a full turn. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Boots of Levitation
entities.description: The wearer can levitate, as the spell, at will by concentrating, for as long as they like. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Mind Reading
entities.description: The wearer can use mind reading, as the spell, as often as they like: a full round of concentration starts it, and it lasts until they stop. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Horn of Panic
entities.description: Played, every creature more than 20 and at most 120 feet from the user must save vs. Spells or be affected by cause fear. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a drum.

entities.name: Lens of Penetrating Vision
entities.description: On command, and while the wearer concentrates, they see through solid matter up to 20 feet, as if in normal light even in darkness: through 3 feet of wood or soil, 1 foot of stone or 1 inch of most metals. Gold or lead foil blocks it. Three times a day, up to a turn each. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a mirror.

Stats.Form: Lens, mirror, pendant or ring (column D)

entities.name: Ring of Protection +1
entities.description: While worn, it gives +1 to Armour Class (1 off descending AC) and +1 to saving throw rolls. Only the strongest protection item worn works. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Protection +2
entities.description: While worn, it gives +2 to Armour Class (2 off descending AC) and +2 to saving throw rolls. Only the strongest protection item worn works. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Protection +3
entities.description: While worn, it gives +3 to Armour Class (3 off descending AC) and +3 to saving throw rolls. Only the strongest protection item worn works. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Protection from Energy Drain
entities.description: Absorbs energy drain, death spells and effects (such as slay living) and curses aimed at the wearer, one charge for each level, curse or spell. Out of charges, it vanishes in golden sparks. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Cloak of Protection from Scrying
entities.description: The wearer can't be scried (crystal balls, clairvoyance, clairaudience or any spying from afar) or have their mind read. Others within 30 feet are also safe from scrying, but not from mind reading. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Ring of Regeneration
entities.description: The wearer regenerates as a troll does, and is just as weak to fire and acid. It heals only damage taken while it is worn. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Crystal Ball of Scrying
entities.description: Only a Magic-User can use it, three times a day for up to a turn each, to see a person or place at any distance. Only the user sees, and there is no sound. Chance of success: 25% for a target only heard of, 55% for one seen briefly, 95% for one known well; +25% with a possession or garment, +50% with a body part such as hair or nail. 100% or more needs no roll. Detect magic, detect evil and mind reading cast through it work 3% per caster level. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a bowl.

Stats.Form: Bowl, crystal ball or mirror (column H)

entities.name: Crystal Ball of Superior Scrying
entities.description: As a crystal ball of scrying, but the user also hears what goes on at the place they see. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a bowl.

Stats.Form: Bowl, crystal ball or mirror (column H)

entities.name: Boots of Speed
entities.description: With a command word (or a click of the heels, for boots) the wearer gets the effect of haste, and ends it the same way, for up to 10 rounds a day in all. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Spell Storing
entities.description: Holds spells any class can cast from it, cast as by the lowest level caster who could, but at least 6th level. Nine in ten hold Magic-User spells, the rest Clerical, never both. It holds 1 to 7 spells (d%: 01-24 one, 25-48 two, 49-67 three, 68-81 four, 82-91 five, 92-96 six, 97-00 seven), each of level 1 to 6 (d%: 01-30 1st, 31-55 2nd, 56-75 3rd, 76-85 4th, 86-97 5th, 98-00 6th). The wearer knows the names of its spells, and it is recharged only by casting the same spells into it. Found charged, empty or in between, as the GM likes. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entities.description: Reflects spells cast directly at the wearer back at the caster, but not area spells: hold person is turned, fireball is not. It turns 2d6 spells before its power is gone. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

Stats.Form: Belt, cloak, pendant or ring (column F)

entities.name: Boots of Stealth
entities.description: The wearer moves almost silently anywhere, with a 90% chance to move silently as the Thief skill. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Telekinesis
entities.description: The wearer can use telekinesis as a 12th level Magic-User, as often as they like, for as long as they concentrate. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Telepathy
entities.description: Three times a day, with its command word, the wearer can read minds within 90 feet for a turn, and send thoughts to any creature whose mind they are reading. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Teleportation
entities.description: On command the wearer casts teleport as a 12th level Magic-User, up to three times a day. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Lens of True Seeing
entities.description: Three times a day it gives the user the true seeing spell, for up to a turn each. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a mirror.

Stats.Form: Lens, mirror, pendant or ring (column D)

entities.name: Boots of Water Walking
entities.description: The wearer walks, runs and moves on any liquid as on firm ground, feet hovering an inch or two above it: mud, oil, snow, quicksand, running water, ice, even lava (whose heat still burns). The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Weakness
entities.description: A cursed item: whoever puts it on has their Strength drop to 3 at once. Only remove curse takes it off. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Ring of Wishes
entities.description: Holds 1d4 wishes when found, which the GM rules on. The item can take another form from the Form of Item table, such as a pendant.

entities.name: Bag of Devouring
entities.description: Looks and tests like a bag of holding and works like one at first, but everything put in it vanishes forever 1d6+6 turns later. It goes on weighing a tenth of what was put in until it is opened and found empty.

entities.name: Bag of Holding
entities.description: A bag about 2 feet wide and 4 feet deep that holds up to 500 pounds and 70 cubic feet, weighing a tenth of what is in it. Things must fit through its 4 foot opening. Punctured or torn, it loses its magic and its contents; turned inside out, it spills them and stops working until turned back. Living creatures inside suffocate within a turn. Lifting it with more than 500 pounds inside tears it. Finding an item in it takes a round without moving.

entities.name: Boots of Traveling and Leaping
entities.description: The wearer can leap up to 10 feet high and 30 feet across, and moves 10 feet more per round on land.

entities.name: Broom of Flying
entities.description: Flies for up to 9 hours a day, carrying 200 pounds at 40 feet or up to 400 pounds at 30 feet. It can fly alone to any place its owner knows well, and comes from up to 300 yards away when its command word is spoken.

entities.name: Efreeti Bottle
entities.description: Once a day, opened (or rubbed, if it is a lamp), it releases the efreeti trapped in it. Roll 1d10 the first time: on a 1 the efreeti is insane and attacks the user until one of them dies; on a 0 it grants three wishes and does nothing else, returning only after each wish, then leaves for good. Otherwise it serves the user up to an hour a day for 101 days from the first opening, then goes free.

entities.name: Flying Carpet
entities.description: A fine rug, typically 5 by 8 feet, that flies carrying up to 500 pounds at 100 feet a round, or up to 1,000 pounds at 50 feet. It can fly at any speed up to that and hover on command.

entities.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
entities.description: Both gloves worn, the wearer has a Strength bonus of +4 instead of their own.

entities.name: Girdle of Giant Strength
entities.description: While worn, the wearer has a Strength bonus of +5 instead of their own, and can throw large stones as a stone giant does.

entities.name: Mirror of Imprisonment
entities.description: A tall mirror set or unset with its command word and “activate” or “deactivate”. Active, anyone within 30 feet who sees their reflection must save vs. Spells or be drawn into one of its 20 cells with all they carry, unable to act. The last person to speak the command word, undead, constructs and eyeless creatures are immune. The controller can call up a prisoner's reflection to talk to, send it back, or free it with “come out”. When all cells are full, a random prisoner is freed to make room. Breaking the mirror frees everyone.

entities.name: Rope of Climbing
entities.description: A 50 foot rope, half an inch thick, that holds 3,000 pounds tied to a secure anchor. Holding one end and speaking its command word, the user makes it snake along at 10 feet a round in any direction, even straight up, and tie itself to an anchor within reach. Untied, it can't lift or hold any weight.

entities.name: Bowl of Summoning Water Elementals
entities.description: A punch bowl of precious metal set with jewels. Filled with at least a quart of fresh water, with the command words around its rim spoken over a full round, it summons a water elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Brazier of Summoning Fire Elementals
entities.description: A small metal brazier about 1½ feet tall. With a fire built in it and the command words on its rim spoken over a full round, it summons a fire elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Censer of Summoning Air Elementals
entities.description: An ornate censer on a chain. With incense lit and covered in it, and the command words on its lid spoken over a full round, it summons an air elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Crucible of Summoning Metal Elementals
entities.description: A small crucible. Set on a solid, heat-proof surface, with the command words on its lid spoken over a full round, it summons a metal elemental. While the elemental is present it is very hot: 2d8 damage to bare hands, 2d6 through gloves or armour. It takes a turn to cool.

entities.name: Mallet of Summoning Wood Elementals
entities.description: A builder's wooden mallet (1d4 damage, not a magic weapon). Held, with the command words on its head spoken over a full round, it summons a wood elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Marble Plate of Summoning Cold Elementals
entities.description: A marble plate about 9 inches across. Set level, with a skin of fresh water poured on it (which freezes into a small statue) and the command words on its rim spoken over a full round, it summons a cold elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Rod of Summoning Lightning Elementals
entities.description: A copper rod 2 feet long, green with verdigris and tipped with amber. Held, with the command words along it spoken over a full round, it summons a lightning elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.

entities.name: Stone of Summoning Earth Elementals
entities.description: A rough-cut, polished stone with a vein of gems. Held in both hands, with the command words on its smoothest side spoken over a full round, it summons an earth elemental. An elemental appears and obeys the summoner, as described for Elementals among the monsters. The GM may allow only some kinds of elementals.
